name: Jezero Crater - western crater floor to delta front
_window_comment: Window in DEM pixel units. col_off and row_off are multiples of 3 so the window edges fall exactly on 6 m orthomosaic pixel edges (20*3 = 6*10). Chosen to contain the Octavia E. Butler landing localization, the Three Forks depot and the Wildcat Ridge delta-front site, as verified against rover waypoint records.
